category_title: Middle school student with autism and language impairment exhibiting socially inappropriate communication
minimal_context: Molly is sitting with her general education reading group while they read an article about Japan, but she has been given a separate coloring worksheet to complete.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The rest of the group is reading an article about Japan. Molly, here is a worksheet for you to color while they read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs aloud) Worksheet for you to color.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, go ahead and start coloring.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes inappropriate noises for bodily functions while sitting next to the group)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work quietly on your coloring.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns her body to look away from the instructional personnel and her collaborative general education classmates, completely ignoring the unrelated worksheet)
